profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built the Disbursements Module (refcode search, per-recipient summary reporting) and Entity Insights dashboard features behind feature flags.
 
Designed the Entity Fundraising Summary data model and GraphQL API powering ActBlue's public donor directory, including a top-ranked donor view.
 
Shipped recurring-contribution improvements (pause proof-of-concept, scheduled cancellation, smart-recurring gating) and a self-serve refund-request system.
 
Lead the Passport Verification system (donor identity/fraud verification) — schema design, validation logic, and retiring the legacy verification module.
 
Across hundreds of shipped changes over 7+ years, consistently own features end-to-end (schema → model/validation → GraphQL API → frontend) and lead the cleanup/deprecation pass after each release.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Built ActBlue's Sift-based fraud-detection system from scratch — vendor dispatch, decisioning, transaction event tracking, and a kill-switch — later extended with Stripe-webhook-driven chargeback and dispute handling.
 
Migrated payments and fraud logging/metrics onto Datadog, including auth/settlement stats, Sidekiq job tracking, and distributed tracing.
 
Expanded Stripe payment processing (merchant accounts, auth/capture, Connect, card-updater ingestion) and major refactoring of the legacy PayPal integration, including recurring reference-transaction support.
 
Selected for a small, cross-team working group to lead the Rails 6.0 upgrade of ActBlue's monolithic application — removed a legacy database-sharding gem and added read-replica support.
 
Built the Entity Bank Account system — state machine, validations, and a custom S3-backed secure document-storage layer for KYC data — and shipped the ACH/Direct Deposit settings UI end to end.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
In addition to the responsibilities held as a Software Engineer:
•	Technical consulting for large product planning timelines and resource allocation congruent with Agile methodologies
•	Providing regular pull request reviews and continued mentorship to junior developers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for all stages of the feature release cycle, from initial design and architecture to development, deployment, and feature maintenance for the needs of the operations, support, and product teams.
•	Technical lead for design and implementation for 3Play Media's assisted transcription and audio description editing tools, an essential component to creating 3Play Media's product and securing it's position in the market.
•	Built and maintains cloud storage delivery integrations (API integrations with Dropbox, Box, Google Drive, Aspera and YouTube)
•	Built and maintains 3Play Media's translation partner integrations (DotSub, Gengo)

positions.title: Web Developer in Training
positions.description:
Launch Academy is a 10-week, immersive bootcamp taking eager learners with little to no experience and teaching them what it takes to add value as a junior contributor to a software engineering team.

The curriculum covers Ruby on Rails full stack development, including Object Oriented Programming, Databases and Schema Design, SQL, Unit Testing and Integration Testing, Rails' MVC pattern, HTML, CSS, Javascript and JQuery.

positions.title: Human Resources Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Sent out offer letters, supporting four HR business partners and the University Recruiting Specialist
•	New Hire Orientations - reserved rooms, ordered food, assisted recruiting specialist with intern orientations.
•	Responsible for E-verify and citizenship verification (Raytheon policy)
•	Posted job postings to America’s Job Exchange
•	Managed background checks, drug testing and IP agreement approvals for new hires prior to start date
•	Managed tuition audit for BBN’s tuition assistance program
•	Created graphs and schematics to illustrate sourcing data, helping strategize which colleges to recruit from
•	Responsible for employment verifications, either over the phone or via Fax with signed release.
•	Responsible for taking notes for biweekly HR Team Tactical Meetings
•	Created walkthrough for the “Electronic Time Recorder” for new hires.
•	Responsible for moving training materials for “Growing Great People Managers” program to BBN’s website
•	Responsible for maintaining ATS (removing duplicate resumes, closing reqs once filled, dispositioning candidates, sustaining communication between Kenexa and BBN’s Offer Extended List)
•	Managed Accepted Offers Whiteboard - list of new hires with start date and pre-employment check statuses
•	Helped Employee engagement taskforce with “Cupcake Survey” aimed to find top reasons employee’s love BBN
•	Confidential Document Management/Organizing personnel files/Company-wide mailings

positions.title: Human Resources Administrator
positions.description:
• Confidential Document Management/Organizing personnel files/Company-wide mailings
• Scheduled meetings between employees and voluntary benefits coordinator
• Edited, reviewed and dispersed company monthly newsletter
• “Walking Towards a New You” Health Awareness Program: 
• Created interactive “Walking Trivia” quiz – employees who participated entered into iPod raffle
• Managed signups and equipment shipments to the teams at each property.
• Coordinated open positions e-mails and lists in order to facilitate transfers between properties
• Helped edit and disperse safety trainings for hurricane safety and first aid
• Data entry for employees newly enrolled in voluntary benefits into the HRIS Database
• Assembled New Hire Packets for Corporate and Property Employees

positions.title: HR Intern
positions.description:
•	Confidential Document Management; Worked with incoming/outgoing mail
•	Covered for front desk administrative assistant- answered clientele phone inquiries
•	Exposure to many different HR concepts/documentation
o	Trained to use E-Verify/I-9 Documentation
o	Assembled new hire packets/ Updated personnel information forms
o	Familiar with 401K documentation
o	Updated/compiled new organization structure charts
o	Maintained affirmative action applicant flow logs
o	Compiled information for 5500 reports
o	Maintained/verified Company OSHA safety records
o	Updated company OSHA safety manual
o	Familiar with creating an online job posting through ADP workforce now
